criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First two lines name agency, Anchorage firm, $89M, June 4, 1,250 MW, Susitna watershed, then land the contrarian thesis. Within the ~210-char see-more cutoff.

criteria.name: Industry relevance
criteria.notes: Every beat names an AK entity and an industry consequence across energy, deep-tech, fisheries, rural health, and defense infrastructure. Preemption beat's AK consequence is lightly drawn.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Named specifics in virtually every sentence: dollar amounts, dates, agencies, bases, deadlines.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: AI-data-center framing attributed to Latitude Media; $89M to ADN; NSF Phase I hedged reportedly (blog source); HB117 akleg primary; AF lease HigherGov primary; RHTP DOH primary. Weakness: single blog for $305K, single-outlet AI framing.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Matches post_001: position-taking, structural (lock-in cuts two ways), inline attribution, no hype, no influencer cadence.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: 431 words, 2700 chars, 1-4 sentence paragraphs, single 3-item bullet block, scans on mobile.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Specific, debatable, tied to the 2030s-baseload-vs-deployable tension plus who decides. Compound structure slightly diffuses the single sharpest debate.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: Four concrete deadlines inside eight weeks (SBIR July 27, AF lease June 29, RHTP June 22, HB117 June 18), each with an AK entry point.

hard_fail_checks.name: punctuation_bans_held
hard_fail_checks.note: Zero em/en-dashes, double-hyphens, colons, semicolons in body.

one_sentence_fix: Cite NSF solicitation 26-510 directly for the $305,000 Phase I figure and note the $700M national package is approximate, to lift every claim to a primary or dual-outlet standard.
